title: loadpath field graph
description: An implicit (field) part, nTop style: named nodes, each a solid (signed distance, negative inside, mm) or a scalar field, where any numeric parameter can be another field.

nodes.description: name -> node. Names are what other nodes and expr refer to.

output.description: The node to mesh (default the last).

bounds.description: Meshing box (default: worked out from the output).

pitch.description: mm grid (default: the box over 4M cells); a third of the thinnest wall or finer

project.description: surface relax+projection rounds (default 3; 0 = raw marching cubes)

anyOf.description: A name: pla, petg, abs, asa, tpu, pa-cf, pa12, pa11, resin, resin-tough, alsi10mg, ti64, 316l (aliases such as 'nylon', 'aluminium', 'steel' work).
A custom material: E (MPa), nu, strength (MPa), density (g/cm³).

minWall.description: mm, the printability check's minimum wall (default 0.8)

build.description: build direction for the overhang check (default +z)

box.description: Axis-aligned box: min/max corners, or center/size.

cylinder.description: Cylinder or tube: end points p0/p1, or center/axis/length; radius r, optional rInner.

mesh.description: A closed mesh: an STL/3MF/OBJ path relative to the study's folder, or inline stlBase64.

union.description: Several shapes acting as one region (a servo's four screw bosses).

shape.title: a shape object (box, cylinder, tube, sphere, mesh, union)
shape.description: A shape: box, cylinder (tube), sphere, mesh or union. Units mm.

node.title: a node object with an 'op'
node.description: A field node: constant, coordinate, distance, shape, mesh, result, grid, remap, expr, union, intersect, subtract, shell, offset, lattice, transform.

bounds.description: Where this solid lives, when it cannot be worked out (meshing needs the output's).

op-coordinate.description: Position along an axis (mm): 'x', 'y', 'z', or a direction from `origin`.

bounds.description: Where this solid lives, when it cannot be worked out (meshing needs the output's).

op-distance.description: Unsigned distance (mm) to a solid's surface (`input`), to points, a segment, a plane or a shape. The usual driver of a ramp: thicker near the bolts, finer cells near the load.

input.title: a number, a node name or a node object
input.description: A number, the name of another node, or an inline node object: anywhere a number goes, a field can drive it.

signed.description: with input: keep the sign (negative inside)

bounds.description: Where this solid lives, when it cannot be worked out (meshing needs the output's).

op-shape.description: An exact primitive solid (box, cylinder, tube, sphere, union), as in a study.

bounds.description: Where this solid lives, when it cannot be worked out (meshing needs the output's).

op-mesh.description: A closed mesh (STL/3MF/OBJ) as a solid: exact distance near its surface, so it re-meshes smooth.

source.description: an in-memory mesh passed to FieldGraph(meshes=)

band.description: mm from the surface within which distance is exact (default 3 pitches); make it cover shell thicknesses

bounds.description: Where this solid lives, when it cannot be worked out (meshing needs the output's).

op-result.description: A simulation result as a scalar field: von Mises stress (MPa) or displacement (mm) of `part` under `study` (analyzed on demand), a saved .npz (points + values, or verify fields), or an in-memory source.

path.description: .npz with points and values (save_result_field) or a grid (origin, pitch, values)

study.description: study JSON, relative to the graph's folder, or 'example:<name>' for a packaged example

part.description: the mesh the study analyzes, or the name of a node of this graph (meshed for the analysis)

pitch.description: mm, meshing a node part for the analysis (default 1)

quantity.description: vonMises (default) or displacement for a study; the array name in an .npz

case.description: one load case (default: the worst at each point)

bounds.description: Where this solid lives, when it cannot be worked out (meshing needs the output's).

op-grid.description: An imported scalar field on a regular grid (.npz with origin, pitch, values[nx,ny,nz]): a temperature map, a CFD pressure, a hand-painted density.

bounds.description: Where this solid lives, when it cannot be worked out (meshing needs the output's).

op-remap.description: Map `input` from [a, b] to [c, d] through a curve (clamped unless clamp is false).

input.title: a number, a node name or a node object
input.description: A number, the name of another node, or an inline node object: anywhere a number goes, a field can drive it.

bounds.description: Where this solid lives, when it cannot be worked out (meshing needs the output's).

op-expr.description: Arithmetic over node names, x, y, z, pi, e and abs sqrt exp log sin cos tan floor ceil sign min max clamp lerp smoothstep step where, e.g. '0.8 + 1.2 * smoothstep(5, 30, stress)'.

additionalProperties.title: a number, a node name or a node object
additionalProperties.description: A number, the name of another node, or an inline node object: anywhere a number goes, a field can drive it.

vars.description: local names for fields used in expr

bounds.description: Where this solid lives, when it cannot be worked out (meshing needs the output's).

op-lattice.description: A TPMS lattice filling all of space (intersect it with a solid). Cell size, wall thickness or relative density can each be a field.

cell.title: a number, a node name or a node object
cell.description: mm per period (default 8); a field grades it

thickness.title: a number, a node name or a node object

density.title: a number, a node name or a node object
density.description: relative density 0.05-0.95 instead of thickness (lattice.py's homogenized tables set the wall)

form.description: sheet (default): a wall on the surface; network: one side solid

grading.description: how a field cell grades: warp (default) bends the lattice's coordinates so one period is one local cell, continuous everywhere; blend cross-fades fixed periods (cylindrical frame)

offset.title: a number, a node name or a node object
offset.description: mm, moves the level surface (network form)

frame.description: cylindrical wraps the cells round an axis
